tools.description: Read the data of one issued invoice (seller, buyer, lines, totals, VAT breakdown, payments) by invoice number, order number or your external id (give exactly one; for an order number with several invoices the last one is returned). tools.name: szamlazz_get_invoice_pdf
tools.description: Download the PDF of one issued document (invoice, pro forma, ...) by invoice number, order number or your external id (give exactly one). Returns the totals and the PDF as an embedded resource. Számla Agent action-szamla_agent_pdf.

tools.name: szamlazz_check_taxpayer
tools.description: Look up a Hungarian taxpayer in the NAV register by the first 8 digits of the tax number (the törzsszám): whether the number is valid, the taxpayer's name, VAT status and addresses. Számla Agent action-szamla_agent_taxpayer (data from the NAV Online Invoice platform).

tools.name: szamlazz_get_receipt
tools.description: Read one issued receipt (nyugta) by receipt number: lines, payments, totals, whether it was reversed. Optionally the PDF. Számla Agent action-szamla_agent_nyugta_get.

tools.name: szamlazz_create_invoice
tools.description: ISSUES a real invoice in Számlázz.hu. A final invoice is reported to NAV (Online Számla) and can only be cancelled by a reversal (szamlazz_reverse_invoice), never deleted. kind: invoice (default), proforma (díjbekérő; not fiscal, can be deleted with szamlazz_delete_proforma), prepayment (előlegszáml

tools.name: szamlazz_reverse_invoice
tools.description: ISSUES a reversal (storno) invoice that cancels one issued invoice. Fiscal: it is reported to NAV and cannot be undone; the original stays in the books. A reversal needs the invoice number of a real invoice. NEVER retried: if the result is unclear, check with szamlazz_get_invoice before trying again

tools.name: szamlazz_delete_proforma
tools.description: DELETES one pro forma invoice (díjbekérő) by its number or by its order number (give exactly one). Only pro forma invoices can be deleted; a real invoice is never touched (use szamlazz_reverse_invoice). Cannot be undone. Számla Agent action-szamla_agent_dijbekero_torlese.

tools.name: szamlazz_register_payment
tools.description: Records 1-5 payments (kifizetés) on one of your own issued invoices or pro forma invoices, which updates its paid amount and outstanding balance. By default the payments are ADDED to the existing ones; replace_existing true REPLACES all earlier payment entries of the invoice. Not fiscal. Számla Agen

tools.name: szamlazz_create_receipt
tools.description: ISSUES a real HUF receipt (nyugta). Receipts are fiscal (NAV reporting) and can only be cancelled by szamlazz_reverse_receipt, never deleted. tools.name: szamlazz_reverse_receipt
tools.description: ISSUES a reversal (storno) receipt that cancels one issued receipt. Fiscal and irreversible; a receipt can be reversed once, and a reversal receipt cannot be reversed. NEVER retried: if the result is unclear, check with szamlazz_get_receipt before trying again. Számla Agent action-szamla_agent_nyugt

tools.name: szamlazz_send_receipt
tools.description: E-MAILS an already issued receipt (PDF) to a customer. Without the e-mail fields, the vendor re-sends the receipt with the settings of the earlier e-mail. The e-mail cannot be recalled. Számla Agent action-szamla_agent_nyugta_send.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "szamlazz_create_invoice" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: szamlazz_create_invoice, szamlazz_reverse_invoice, szamlazz_reverse_receipt · Private data: szamlazz_get_invoice_pdf, szamlazz_create_invoice, szamlazz_register_payment · Public sink: szamlazz_create_invoice, szamlazz_send_receipt · Destructive: szamlazz_delete_proforma.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: szamlazz_create_invoice, szamlazz_reverse_invoice, szamlazz_reverse_receipt · Private data: szamlazz_get_invoice_pdf, szamlazz_create_invoice, szamlazz_register_payment · Public sink: szamlazz_create_invoice, szamlazz_send_receipt · Destructive: szamlazz_delete_proforma

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
